focus: Volt Typhoon living-off-the-land in OT-adjacent network segments using certutil, ntdsutil, wmic
signal_source: cloud_cluster: 'Volt Typhoon Pre-Positions in US Critical Infrastructure via Living-off-the-Land' (reach_score=91, conf=91)

hypotheses.behavior: T1218 - System Binary Proxy Execution (certutil, wmic for C2 and recon)
hypotheses.finding_summary: certutil and wmic process creation events present in index. 847 certutil events found across 90-day window — all mapped to expected IT patch management scripts (certutil -hashfile for integrity checks). No anomalous parent processes, no network connections following certutil execution. Documented as FP pattern.

hypotheses.behavior: T1049 - System Network Connections Discovery (ntdsutil for AD recon, unusual outbound from domain controllers)
hypotheses.finding_summary: 2 ntdsutil executions in 90-day window. Both traced to a scheduled domain backup task run by svc-adbackup at 02:00 on the first Sunday of each month. No anomalous execution times or parent processes.

hypotheses.behavior: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols (C2 over HTTPS to 192.0.2.77)
hypotheses.finding_summary: No connections to 192.0.2.77 in any network index in the 90-day window. IP also not present in proxy, DNS, or firewall logs. Negative result is meaningful — proxy and network logs are healthy (verified via 30-day event count).

key_fp_notes: certutil -hashfile executions are routine in this environment from the SCCM patch pipeline. The parent process is always C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe. Any certutil execution with a different parent or with -urlcache/-decode flags should be treated as suspicious. svc-adbackup running ntdsutil on Sunday mornings is expected and documented.
re_hunt_trigger: Re-run if: (1) new Volt Typhoon IOC infrastructure is published, (2) any certutil execution appears with -urlcache or -decode flags, (3) SCADA-adjacent network segment logging is enabled (see Gap H3 note).
